verdict.rationale: Otter has a public pricing page that lists tier-differentiating features, such as the free tier's 3 lifetime file imports, 3 concurrent meetings, team vocabulary, Salesforce/HubSpot/Zapier integrations, API & Webhooks and enhanced admin features. Community posts mention free users and call Otter affordable for individuals, which shows you can start free without talking to sales. However, the evidence shows no prices and does not map which features belong to which tier. Missing for 10: actual per-tier prices, a clear tier-by-tier feature mapping, explicit confirmation of which tiers are self-serve versus sales-gated, and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
